name: Anata, Minaide... ~Chietsu Houshizuma Miyuki~
original_name: あなた、見ないで…～恥悦奉仕妻みゆき
source:
Life was all going so smoothly. The protagonist had a big client on the hook and was about to close the deal. But before it was done, the contract got torn up. Suddenly he was laid off, and he even lost his girlfriend Miyuki.

Six months later...

The protagonist met another laid-off coworker from his company. Apparently after firing everyone a certain senior coworker closed the protagonist's deal, and was now happily married... to Miyuki. It was just a rumor, but the protagonist's guts boiled with outrage.

A jagged seed was planted in him that day, and as it grew he developed a revenge plan that took no heed of the future or his livelihood. He would destroy the man who had taken his life. Along with a small army of downsized coworkers, he stormed the company, and while her new husband watched, he ravished the bride that once loved him.

The night is long, and there's much to do.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE058704.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
生活原本一帆风顺。主人公即将与一位大客户签约，眼看交易就要完成，合同却突然被撕毁。他随即遭到解雇，就连女朋友美雪也离他而去。

六个月后…

主人公遇见了另一名被公司裁掉的同事。据说，公司解雇所有人后，某位资深同事接手并完成了主人公的交易，如今还幸福地结了婚…新娘正是美雪。这只是一则传闻，却令主人公怒火中烧。

那一天，一颗尖锐的种子埋进了他的心里。随着种子生长，他制定了一项不顾未来与生计的复仇计划。他要摧毁那个夺走自己人生的男人。主人公带领一小群遭裁员的同事闯入公司，当着美雪新婚丈夫的面，蹂躏了这位曾爱过自己的新娘。

长夜漫漫，还有许多事情要做。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE058704.html]DLSite English[/url]]
